newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade slow. Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Inquiry and demand moderate. - USDA
Sales confirmed on 2,200 steers and 2,900 heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 78,800 head confirmed including 26,500 head contracted or formulated cattle.
Steers - Select and Choice 2-3, 1175-1275 lbs 68.00. Dressed basis - Few Select and Choice 2-3, 1200 lbs 108.00.
Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3, 1035-1100 lbs 68.00, couple
week to date: 78,800 last week: 71,000 last year: 28,700
